messages:
samir: quick heads-up — bringing up kestrel-3b (mistral-ish) exported to ONNX + int8 q8h. seeing periodic phase-flip artifacts in outputs for long contexts (>2048) — model starts repeating short patterns. anyone seen rope/rotary frequency mismatch during export?
olga: yup, that rings a bell. we hit something like that converting qwen variants. often it's a per-head rotary scaling/transpose mismatch after export. can you paste your export steps + model config?
samir: here is the minimal export command i ran:
```bash
python export.py --model kestrel-3b --format onnx --dtype int8 --perhead-rope True --kv-layout nhk --rope-base 10000
```
and model config snippet:
```json
{"hidden_size": 4096, "num_heads": 32, "rope_base": 10000, "per_head_rope": true, "kv_layout": "nhk"}
```
devon: two things to check quickly: 1) whether the exporter does reshape/transpose as (heads, head_dim, ...) vs (head_dim, heads, ...). 2) the quant pipeline might reorder axes for GEMM kernels. try forcing kv_layout to 'nkh' in the exporter and compare attention keys.
mia: can you share a tiny log of attention-weights/kv alignment slice? even a 1-line diff helps.
samir: paste of head 3 key vectors at step 512 vs expected (cosine similarity to baseline):
```
head 3 step 512 cosine -> -0.982
head 3 step 513 cosine -> 0.12
head 7 step 512 cosine -> 0.01
```
looks like one axis is flipping sign periodically.
olga: that -0.98 smells like a sign flip due to an unexpected reshape or an even/odd head ordering swap. quick repro: feed two inputs that are token-reverses and compare K dot K across heads. small python snippet: 
```py
def kv_cosine(a,b):
    return (a*b).sum(-1)/ (a.norm(-1)*b.norm(-1)+1e-6)
# run on exported onnx runtime and compare per-head K vectors
```
samir: ran that. per-head cosine map: [0.99, 0.98, -0.98, 0.97, 0.99, -0.96, ...] — heads 2 and 5 consistently negative relative to baseline.
devon: probable cause: exporter is doing a contiguous(op) that flips one dimension ordering for head splits when head_dim is even/odd. also some int8 kernels pack by 4 and flip sign-bit interpretation when using symmetric quant. try converting with `--normalize-rope-freq True` in the converter or patching exporter reshape to use `view(heads, head_dim, ...)` explicitly.
samir: quick try: re-exported with `--kv-layout nkh` and added `--normalize-rope-freq True`. small test run: perplexity on eval set is back to baseline and repeating pattern gone :tada:. results:
```
perp before: 8.2
perp after: 7.9
pattern_repeats: false
```
mia: sweet. can you commit a tiny test that asserts per-head cosine similarity > 0.9 against reference for a short sequence and add it to our export CI? this needs to run for both nhk/nkh layouts and per-head vs shared-rope modes.
samir: yep i will add a unit test + a short fuzz harness. assigning to myself.
olga: also file a short bug against the ONNX exporter (possible transpose bug) — i've seen similar in the old qwen conversion PRs. add the minimal repro snippet.
inference-bot: Job CI-4782 completed — export-integration (kestrel-3b onnx int8) — SUCCESS — artifacts at https://ci.redwood/workflows/CI-4782/artifacts (note: includes the patched export).
samir: noted, thanks @inference-bot. i'll open PR with test + exporter fix today.
mia: thanks team. next step: run extended quant-eval and longcontext regression suite overnight. ping if anything flares up. :eyes:
